name: いわて三陸 希望のまちめぐり〜Build Back Better〜
original_name: いわて三陸 希望のまちめぐり〜Build Back Better〜
overview: Almost 15 years have passed since the Great East Japan Earthquake. We will take you on a journey through Iwate's "now" while touching on the exchanges between Hyogo and Iwate, the lessons learned from the earthquake, and the road to recovery, and conveying the diverse charms of Iwate and Sanriku.
